title: UI风格#200 - Elegant Art Nouveau (优雅新艺术)
description: 创建第200种UI风格：优雅新艺术风格 - 流畅曲线、花卉图案、复古优雅。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGR.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Elegant Art Nouveau style When color palette Then features sage green, cream, gold, burgundy
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#8FBC8F (鼠尾草绿), #FAF8F0 (奶油), #D4AF37 (金), #800020 (勃艮第红)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Elegant Art Nouveau style When typography Then uses elegant display: Poiret One, Art Nouveau
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Poiret One (艺术), Art Nouveau (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Elegant Art Nouveau style When layout Then flowing curves, organic patterns, asymmetrical balance
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：流畅曲线、有机图案、不对称平衡

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Elegant Art Nouveau style When UI elements Then floral ornaments, gilded details, pastel gradients
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：花卉装饰、镀金细节、柔和渐变

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Elegant Art Nouveau UI When functional Then includes salon chat, artisan agents, grace stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：沙龙聊天、工匠代理、优雅统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Elegant Art Nouveau UI When copy Then uses grace: 'Grace', 'Flourish', 'Bloom', 'Verdant'
